hypotheses.X1_fixed_norm_assignment: The diagonal target/source pairing maximizes the fixed-norm class-effect assignment with exact permutation p at most 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.X2_fixed_norm_row_wins: The own-category subspace is the largest fixed-norm class effect in at least four eligible target rows on every corpus.
hypotheses.X3_selectivity_assignment: After normalizing class effect by total Fisher effect magnitude, the diagonal assignment remains significant at p at most 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.X4_natural_ablation_assignment: Without amplifying the removed projection, the diagonal class-effect assignment has p at most 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.X5_random_positive_assignment: The fixed-norm diagonal assignment remains significant on random-positive contexts in every corpus.
